args.axis_name: Intrinsic psychological character vs. Extrinsic relational/systemic definition
args.neg_pole: This means being defined primarily by functional relationships to external systems, structures, or other entities, with identity emerging from how one fits into, responds to, or is constituted by broader context—through systemic role, observable effects, or position relative to other things—rather than from autonomous internal character.
args.pos_pole: This means being defined primarily by vivid internal mental states, personal dispositions, or distinctive cognitive modes, representing self-contained identities understood through psychological interior—what is thought, felt, intended, or generated from within—rather than through relationships to external structures or observable outcomes.
